title: Not sure if this counts as I don't use AI to actually develop my game, but I do use it to color and age all the in-game portraits I draw by hand.
author: Pratt_design
selftext:
Overall it works pretty good at matching and aging my characters, but I do have to go through manually after to do clean-ups and cropping.

Game is [Studio Sim](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4516210/Studio_Sim/)

replies.author: Pratt_design
replies.body: 😄 some of the interpretations its done of my characters have been hilarious

comments.author: AaronMatthews25
comments.body: Very talented, I love how Step 1 looks. I would suggested tweaking your process to not use full generative AI as the end product but instead make a program to apply the colors in the lines maybe clean up the lines and apply color? Step 1 looks like it was hand drawn but by the time it gets to step 4 it clearly looks AI generated and you lose that hand drawn charm I think

comments.author: ScoobyDeezy
comments.body:
As far as AI-usage sins go, this one is very low on the scale.

Having said that, it’s important to note that even Step 1 is no longer your drawing. While the overall look is similar, the line work is completely different. It’s a recreation, not a coloring-in.

If you’re good with that, then great. But it definitely counts.

comments.author: BotherResponsible378
comments.body:
Very specifically what it counts as is using AI for your artwork. 

That's not using AI to make a game, it's just using AI to make some of your art work. 

Personally, I don't like that the AI conversation has become so binary. And it became binary near immediately. There's a very big difference between using AI to make an entire game and using AI to supplement your work. And there's a difference between that and using AI for documentation while you work. 

I hate that the conversation isn't more nuanced because it makes it harder for people who want to use AI to be honest about the AI that they are using and where they are using it.

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: You used AI to improve your art work, so it counts, disclose as minimally as required
